caption: The drawing depicts a wooden device resembling a clamp or vice. The object consists primarily of two vertical wooden beams with a rectangular cross-section, positioned parallel to each other. These beams are medium brown in color with visible wood grain and some darker shaded areas to indicate texture and form. Near the top of the beams, a horizontal wooden rod passes through both vertical posts, securing them in place. At the bottom, another horizontal wooden piece joins the vertical beams. Below this, two additional horizontal wooden planks are stacked, each showing a greenish-brown hue with pronounced grain lines and surface marks. There is a round, screw-like mechanism on the left-hand side of the device, featuring a cylindrical turning handle, which is also rendered in a light brown wood tone. The drawing is labeled "Henry Waldeck" at the bottom, centered. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or detailing present.
title: Pegging Jack
